rules.title: Boston fair housing ban on discrimination, including based on rental assistance (source of income)
rules.requirement: In Boston, landlords may not discriminate when renting housing based on protected classes. These include race, disability, family status, and receipt of rental assistance such as Section 8, social security disability, or veterans vouchers. Refusing to accept rental assistance is an example of discrimination.
rules.coverage_conditions: All housing rentals, sales and financing within the City of Boston.
rules.citation: Boston fair housing law enforced by the Boston Fair Housing Commission (ordinance citation not stated on page)
rules.quoted_span: In the City of Boston, it’s illegal to discriminate when renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing.
rules.conflict_note: The page is a summary and gives no ordinance citation or effective date. The commission also enforces state and federal fair housing laws.
